objective: Improve the physical-input-only opening forecast while retaining exact per-step physics. Fixed 0.35 ms transport reproduced 6/12 stratified v1 openings even though measured wire timing replay matched every checked event.
estimator: Fit plant timing, never a policy. Use only the sixteen original training donors for calibration. Pair wire sends and receipts by direction and FIFO payload. Anchor sends to the observed client flush/attack-consume or server drain/tracker stage at which this simulator generates the packet. For each ping bin, estimate stage-to-receipt overhead and downlink receipt-to-task-enqueue time separately for tracker/metadata, own status, target status and own velocity. Pool within a donor, then weight native donors equally. Declare exclusions with counts. Resolve missing strata with training-only pooled distributions. Candidate quantiles .25, .50 and .75, with and without enqueue service. Select by exact two-second openings, then mean maximum position error. Keep historical fixed and timing-grid results.
validation: Freeze the selected parameter file before the first robust native results. The predeclared test takes the first two-science-POV fight for every combination of W-tap, Hold-W, hybrid, PPO and population, both seats and symmetric 0 or 80 ms on MMC. Evaluate the selected shape and the original fixed model on the same twenty openings. No actual wire times are given to either forecast. Treat this as a test of host transport and combat forecasting, independently of the real ring-out tournament.
